annual.debt_basis: total tag (LongTermDebt, long-term incl. current maturities) + short-term borrowings (ShortTermBorrowings)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dividends_paid.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

legs.dividends_paid: not filed for any of the four quarters
legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.note: neither bound — a positive leg and the issuance leg are both incomplete
